_about: One example request per MCP tool (HIR-366). The robot visitor (web/e2e/mcp-watch.spec.js) calls every tool listed here on the live site after each deploy and every morning; a tool that errors or answers without what `expect` names fails the check, which rolls back a deploy and files a ticket.
Adding a tool: add its entry here. tests/test_mcp_examples.py fails until every tool the server offers has one, and runs each example against test data.
ask: the request in plain words; it becomes the check's name and the ticket's title.
arguments: the tool's arguments. A value {"from": "<tool>", "path": "a.0.b"} is taken from that tool's own example answer, e.g. a job id from a search.
expect: paths that must hold a value that is not null, zero, empty text or an empty list. "jobs[].title": jobs is a non-empty list and every job in it has a title.
Keep every example cheap and on data that is always there: a busy city, no rare skill. An empty answer here rolls back a deploy.

search_jobs.ask: search for open AI engineer jobs in Berlin

get_job.ask: get the full details of one job from that search

skill_demand.ask: which skills Munich jobs ask for most

related_skills.ask: what else open jobs that require Python ask for

rising_skills.ask: which skills are rising and falling in Berlin jobs

match_profile.ask: rank recent Berlin jobs for a mid-level Python and RAG engineer
